backups.title: Database backups
backups.intro: Every night at 2:15 Postaja saves the whole database (pg_dump) to a separate bucket. Backups run in production only; dev is never backed up.

credits.title: Credits
credits.intro: Every paid AI action costs credits from the price list below. An organization first uses its plan's monthly credits (Admin → organization → Credits per month; empty = unlimited), then bought packs, valid 12 months. The € spend cap stays as the safety limit. Until payments exist (TASK-036) owners request packs in the app and you grant them once paid.

billing.title: Payments
billing.intro: Subscriptions, the agency pilot and credit packs go through Stripe Checkout; invoices, cards and cancelling are handled by Stripe (customer portal). Postaja learns the state only from signed webhooks.
billing.webhookHint: Stripe webhook: /api/stripe/webhook, events checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, customer.subscription.created/updated/deleted. In the customer portal enable plan changes and cancelling.

files.title: Brand files
files.intro: Logos, fonts and documents of the brand. Postaja uses document text as facts when it writes posts; logo and fonts are for images. Only members of this organization can see the files.

files.dropBody: Documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, TXT), images, fonts (TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2) or a whole ZIP. Every file is sorted for you: images with “logo” in the name go to logos, fonts to fonts, everything else to sources.

Posts.aiLabelTitle: This post shows an AI-generated person — label it when you publish.

aiLabelHow.instagram: Instagram: when posting, open Advanced settings and turn on the AI label ("Add AI label").
aiLabelHow.facebook: Facebook: when posting, turn on the AI label ("Add AI label") in the post options.
aiLabelHow.tiktok: TikTok: when posting, turn on "AI-generated content" under More options.

Posts.aiLabelExport: The EU AI Act (Article 50) requires a realistic AI-generated person to be disclosed. The export (ZIP) therefore adds a note at the end of the text, and images and videos carry an AI label in their file data.

Connect.title: Claude
Connect.intro: Connect your Claude to Postaja. In a conversation Claude can then send the CGP and materials from your projects straight to a brand, and you review everything here.
Connect.step1: In Claude (claude.ai or the desktop app) open Settings → Connectors and add a custom connector.
Connect.step2: Name it Postaja and paste the URL above.
Connect.step3: Click Connect. Postaja opens: sign in with your email and open the link from the mail in the same browser.
Connect.step4: Allow access. Then say in a conversation, e.g. “Send this CGP to Postaja for the brand inzenirji”.
Connect.tools: Claude sees your organization's brands and their CGPs. An owner can propose a CGP through Claude (stored as a proposal you confirm on the brand page) and add text materials.
Connect.editorNote: As an editor you can only read brands through Claude; the owner proposes CGPs and adds materials.
Connect.noActivity: Claude has not done anything yet.

Persona.title: Persona (AI influencer)
Persona.intro: A persona is the brand's recurring AI person. From its DNA and passport pictures Postaja generates the same person every time – for pictures and videos (Kling 3.0).
Persona.introPersona: From the DNA and passport pictures Postaja generates the same person every time. The primary picture is where every new picture and video starts.
Persona.noneText: The brand owner creates the persona.
Persona.aiTitle: Describe the person – AI fills in the DNA
Persona.aiHint: Roughly describe the person you want (or paste/import an existing DNA). Claude fills in all 13 DNA fields; you can edit them afterwards.
Persona.textPlaceholder: e.g. 25-year-old Slovenian woman, sporty, short dark hair, loves nature and coffee …
Persona.textHint: Everything you write stays in the DNA; Claude adds what is missing.
Persona.filling: Claude is filling in the DNA …
Persona.manualTitle: Or fill in the DNA yourself
Persona.manualHint: Fields of the DNA framework; * are required. Write in English – an image model reads the DNA.
Persona.name: Name
Persona.passportHint: 3–{max} pictures of the same person; one is primary. The passport picture is a photoreal close-up made with a prompt that includes the whole DNA (Nano Banana Pro). Competitors.title: Competitors
Competitors.intro: From the CGP and with web search, Claude proposes the brand's competitors: website, public profiles and why each competes. Keep or remove suggestions, or add your own. The kept ones are analysed later (what we adopt, what we avoid, topic gaps). Postaja reads public pages only.

Competitors.analyzeIntro: Postaja reads the kept competitors' public websites and Claude compares them, together with your screenshots, with the CGP: what we adopt, what we avoid and which topics we are missing. Nothing is copied — only patterns.
Competitors.analyzeHint: Takes up to a few minutes. At most {cost}. Earlier analyses stay.

ApprovalLinks.title: Client link
ApprovalLinks.intro: Through the link, the agency's client sees this brand's posts for the chosen days (texts, images, videos) and approves each or asks for changes with a comment — without a Postaja account. An approval marks the post approved; a change request moves an approved post back to ready. The link works until 14 days after the last day and can be revoked at any time.
